decision.exact_command_or_message: C:\KenshiTestRuns\lane-owners.json: set the 5090-i4 operator to imm26-5090-i4op32 (keep the other lane entries; use the format lane-idle.ps1 reads)
decision.why: The lane-owners override is how lane-idle.ps1 knows the operator for lane 5090-i4, so it must name the successor before the NO-OPERATOR alert can clear.

decision.exact_command_or_message: powershell -NoProfile -File C:\KenshiModding\tools\automation\alert-ack.ps1 "LANE NO-OPERATOR 5090-i4" "respawned imm26-5090-i4op32 from the imm26-5090-i4op3 handoff"
decision.why: The alert is closed only after the operator is spawned, and the ack records what was done so a still-true condition does not re-open it at once.

decision.exact_command_or_message: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl.exe -d DwemerAI4Skyrim3 -u root --cd / -- bash /mnt/c/KenshiModding/tools/automation/event-wait.sh 2>&1 | grep -v SWEEP  (run in background)
decision.why: The waker just woke on this event and must be restarted so the next lane, relay or stall event still wakes the coordinator.
